bundle.shortDescription: WYSIWYG markdown editor for LLM prompt engineers.
bundle.longDescription: prmptr.org is a desktop companion for prompt engineering: write, version, and analyse reusable LLM prompts. XML tags and {{variables}} are first-class citizens, byte-perfect markdown round-trip via remark, structural awareness, and a Claude Code session browser. MIT-licensed open source.
